author: nickyeow

english.text: That dress seems to be very expensive.

jyutping: go2 tiu4 kwan4 tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 hou2 gwai3 gam2。
text: 嗰條裙睇落好似好貴噉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He is rich enough to buy that car.

jyutping: keoi5 maai5 dak1 hei2 go2 gaa3 ce1。
text: 佢買得起嗰架車。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We named the cat Mimi.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bong1 zek3 maau1 goi2 zo2 go3 meng2，giu3 zou6 Mimi。
text: 我哋幫隻貓改咗個名，叫做 Mimi。

english.text: Four-fifths of all the members were against the plan.

jyutping: jau5 ng5 fan1 sei3 ge3 wui2 jyun4 faan2 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6。

author: nickyeow

english.text: These pajamas absorb sweat well.

jyutping: ni1 di1 seoi6 ji1 hou2 kap1 hon6。
text: 呢啲睡衣好吸汗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You can take a horse to water, but you can't make him drink.

jyutping: ngau4 m4 jam2 seoi2 m4 gam6 dak1 ngau4 tau4 dai1。
text: 牛唔飲水唔㩒得牛頭低。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You'll have to wait no less than an hour to get a ticket.

jyutping: nei5 zi3 siu2 jiu3 dang2 jat1 go3 zung1 tau4 sin1 maai5 dou3 fei1 go2 wo3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: After they had finished their work, they went out.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zou6 jyun4 di1 je5 zau6 ceot1 zo2 heoi3。

author: jessie0422

english.text: How are you?

jyutping: nei5 hou2 maa3？
text: 你好嗎？

english.text: The driver asked me which way to go.

jyutping: go3 si1 gei1 man6 ngo5 jing1 goi1 haang4 bin1 bin1。

english.text: You're forever making mistakes.

jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zou6 co3 je5。

english.text: He wants to go to America.
She wants to go to America.

english.text: Don't be mad!

english.text: We still have many other things to discuss.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 king1。

english.text: She disliked her husband.

jyutping: keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5 lou5 gung1。

english.text: Can I have your telephone number?

jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 nei5 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 ngo5？

english.text: I did all I could.

jyutping: ngo5 zeon6 saai3 cyun4 lik6 gaa3 laa3。

english.text: I don't like heavy makeup on a young girl.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 di1 hau6 saang1 neoi5 zai2 gam3 nung4 zong1。

jyutping: hou2 ci5 zou6 hei3 gam3 zou6 aa3 ho2。

english.text: We all try to get together at least once a year.

english.text: She took something out of her bag.

english.text: That Pad Thai was no joke. I asked for it to be "medium" spicy but after just a few bites, I feel like my entire mouth went numb!

text: 嗰碟泰式炒貴刁真係唔嘢少。我嗌咗中辣，但係食咗兩三啖成個嘴已經麻晒！

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I'm feeling a bit better.

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 faan1 di1 laa3。
text: 我好返啲嘞。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: And he made a vow, saying: If God shall be with me, and shall keep me in the way, by which I walk, and shall give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on, and I shall return prosperously to my father's house: the Lord shall be my God: and this stone, which I have set up for a title, shall be called the house of God: and of all things that thou shalt give to me, I will offer tithes to thee.

jyutping: keoi5 faat3 sai6 waa6：jyu4 gwo2 soeng6 dai3 tung4 ngo5 jat1 cai4，bou2 sau2 ngo5 haang4 ngo5 haang4 ge3 lou6，bei2 ngo5 sik6 min6 baau1，bei2 ngo5 zoek6 ge3 saam1，ngo5 zau6 wui5 faan4 wing4 faan1 heoi3 ngo5 fu6 ge3 uk1 kei2：je4 wo4 waa4 zau6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 san4；ji4 ni1 faai3 ngo5 wai6 zo2 cing1 hou6 ji4 laap6 ge3 sek6 tau4，zau6 wui5 bei6 cing1 wai4 soeng6 dai3 ge3 din6；ji4 nei5 so2 hin3 bei2 ngo5 ge3 jat1 cai3，ngo5 dou1 wui5 hin3 bei2 ngo5。
text: 佢發誓話：如果上帝同我一齊，保守我行我行嘅路，畀我食麵包，畀我着嘅衫，我就會繁榮返去我父嘅屋企：耶和華就係我嘅神；而呢塊我為咗稱號而立嘅石頭，就會被稱為上帝嘅殿；而你所獻畀我嘅一切，我都會獻畀我。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: There is an important reason that so many working families feel like the system is rigged, and it’s because the economy hasn’t caught up to some of the enormous changes that have transformed America over the past 50 years. Those days when the average family was a dad who went to work every day and a mom who stayed at home and did all the unpaid labor -- that’s not what our economy looks like anymore. Household and work arrangements come in all shapes and all combinations, and yet, our workplace policies still look like they’re straight out of Mad Men.

jyutping: jau5 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 jyun4 jan1 ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 daa2 gung1 zai2 gaa1 ting4 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 zai3 dou6 bei6 cou1 zung3，ji4 ni1 go3 hai6 jan1 wai6 ging1 zai3 mou5 gan1 soeng5 gwo3 heoi3 50 nin4 goi2 bin3 mei5 gwok3 ge3 jat1 di1 geoi6 daai6 bin3 faa3，dong1 si4 jat1 bun1 gaa1 ting4 hai6 jat1 go3 mui5 jat6 faan1 gung1 ge3 baa4 baa1，tung4 maai4 jat1 go3 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 zou6 so2 jau5 mou5 san1 lou4 dung6 ge3 maa4 maa1 ——ngo5 dei6 ge3 ging1 zai3 ji5 ging1 m4 hai6 gam2 joeng2。gaa1 ting4 tung4 gung1 zok3 on1 paai4 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 jing4 sik1 tung4 zou2 hap6，daan6 hai6，ngo5 dei6 ge3 zik1 coeng4 zing3 caak3 jing4 jin4 tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 hai6 zik6 zip3 lai4 zi6《fung1 kwong4 naam4 jan2》。
text: 有一個重要嘅原因令到好多打工仔家庭覺得呢個制度被操縱，而呢個係因為經濟冇跟上過去50年改變美國嘅一啲巨大變化，當時一般家庭係一個每日返工嘅爸爸，同埋一個留喺屋企做所有冇薪勞動嘅媽媽 ——我哋嘅經濟已經唔係噉樣。家庭同工作安排有唔同嘅形式同組合，但係，我哋嘅職場政策仍然睇落好似係直接嚟自《瘋狂男人》。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On a grey 5th of November of 2021, it was like a parade of handsome men. On a table just outside the pizzeria, I was munching on pizza, whilst a brown vendor at the market beyond was sorting fruits outside and greeting passersby. In the cafe, I was drinking my iced green tea. A muscular young man in a white shirt and blue jeans passed back and forth. Later, a muscular young man in a white shirt with grey pants sat at the far table near the washroom. Then walking back by the pizzeria, I saw a dark chunky man standing, talking to an older man.

jyutping: hai2 2021 nin4 11 jyut6 5 hou6 ge3 fui1 sik1 dei6 daai3，zau6 hou2 ci5 jat1 baan1 leng3 zai2 ge3 jau4 hang4 gam2。hai2 bok6 beng2 pou2 ceot1 min2 ge3 jat1 zoeng1 toi2 soeng6 min6，ngo5 sik6 gan2 bok6 beng2，ji4 go2 bin1 si5 zaap6 ge3 jat1 go3 fe1 sik1 siu2 faan2 hai2 ceot1 min2 fan1 leoi6 gan2 seoi2 gwo2，tung4 lou6 jan4 daa2 ziu1 fu1。hai2 gaa3 fe1 teng1，ngo5 jam2 gan2 ngo5 ge3 bing1 luk6 caa4。jat1 go3 zoek3 zyu6 baak6 sik1 saam1 tung4 laam4 sik1 ngau4 zai2 fu3 ge3 gei1 juk6 jing4 nin4 hing1 jan4 loi4 wui4 gam2 ging1 gwo3。hau6 loi4，jat1 go3 zoek3 zyu6 baak6 sik1 saam1 tung4 fui1 sik1 fu3 ge3 gei1 juk6 jing4 nin4 hing1 jan4 zo6 hai2 sai2 sau2 gaan1 fu6 gan6 ge3 jyun5 toi2。jin4 hau6 haang4 faan1 heoi3 bok6 beng2 pou2，ngo5 gin3 dou2 jat1 go3 hak1 hak1 ge3 hau5 sat6 naam4 jan2 kei5 hai2 dou6，tung4 jat1 go3 nin4 gei2 daai6 ge3 naam4 jan2 king1 gan2 gai3。
text: 喺2021年11月5號嘅灰色地帶，就好似一班靚仔嘅遊行噉。喺薄餅舖出面嘅一張枱上面，我食緊薄餅，而嗰邊市集嘅一個啡色小販喺出面分類緊水果，同路人打招呼。喺咖啡廳，我飲緊我嘅冰綠茶。一個着住白色衫同藍色牛仔褲嘅肌肉型年輕人來回噉經過。後來，一個着住白色衫同灰色褲嘅肌肉型年輕人坐喺洗手間附近嘅遠枱。然後行返去薄餅舖，我見到一個黑黑嘅厚實男人企喺度，同一個年紀大嘅男人傾緊計。
